caption: The drawing depicts a dark green skirt with a fitted waistband and gently flared panels. The waistband is decorated with an embroidered floral design featuring pink, yellow, and blue flowers with green leaves and brown stems. There are two small pockets on the front of the skirt, one on each side, each outlined in pink and adorned with a matching pink bow and floral embroidery similar to the waistband. Near the bottom of the skirt on each side, there are larger embroidered floral motifs in pink, blue, green, and brown. The skirt has light pink piping along the seams and hem as well as along the waistband and pocket edges. A matching sash, also trimmed in pink, is attached to the waistband on one side, ending in a bow. The background is a plain off-white color.
title: Apron
